question: Microfiltration and sterile filtration in the treatment of water for pharmaceutical use:

options.opa: Separates small particles in the range between 0.1 - 10 μm.
options.opb: They are used to clarify solutions.
options.opc: Eliminates all viral contamination from a topical preparation.
options.opd: It is only used to remove particles with a diameter greater than 0.001 μm from a liquid.
